name: Ticketmeo – Sell Tickets – Event Ticketing
author: Joss Hughes

sections.description:
The Ticketmeo Widget plugin allows your customers to sell tickets online direct from your WordPress website, with the power of the Ticketmeo ticketing platform. Our plugin is free to install and use, with a small booking fee taken for all paid events which can be paid by the customer. All free events are free.

Ticketmeo provides you with all the features you need to manage your event from selling tickets to checking in your customers with our simple to use QR Code based check in app available on both iOS and Android.

› See a live preview of our plugin in use.

Everything You Need To Manage Your Events

  • 🕗 Recurring Event Support
    Create multiple dates for one event without having to setup a new event every time the event occurs.
  • 🛒 Simple Checkout
    We keep your checkout progress short so your customers don’t have to fill pages full of forms to purchase their tickets.
  • 🎫 Unlimited Ticket Types
    No limit on the number of tickets on sale, with the ability to sell different ticket types ie. Standard, Premium, VIP.
  • 🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Grouped Tickets
    Sell different ticket types for a single section with different price points ie. Adult, Child, Student, OAP.
  • ❓ Custom Checkout Questions
    Modify your checkout form and ask custom questions in relation to your event, ie. food options or where they heard of you from.
  • 🏷️ Advanced Discount Codes
    Give discounts to your customers by offering discount codes with a set reduction or percentage reduction based on criteria you set such as minimum spend, minimum tickets, restricted events.
  • 📞 Sell Offline Tickets
    Create unlimited orders in the backend for free for tickets sold either in person or over the phone and record any payments taken.
  • 🎟️ Automatic e-tickets
    Attendees get their tickets instantly, with eTickets which can be customised to add important details about the event, ie. entrance details etc.
  • ✏️ Attendee Management
    Manage your attendees in the control panel; with the ability to change details, void tickets, refund tickets and modify tickets.
  • 📱 Check In App with Ticketmeo Scan
    Use our quick and easy check in app to check in your attendees to the event. Find out more about our app.
  • 🔐 Access Control
    Restrict who can see your ticket pages by restricting your ticket pages with a password.
  • 🧩 Expand With Zapier
    Extend your ticketing needs by creating automatic zap’s with Zapier and send your ticket data to other platforms; ie. Salesforce, Google Sheets, ID Printing Software
  • 🖼️ Seamless Integration
    With our theme editor you can create a design which looks like your WordPress website so they do not know we exist.
  • 💰 Instant Payments Direct
    We use Stripe or PayPal so all of your payments are sent directly to you, we do not hold you funds for a period of time.
  • 🌍 Multi Language Support
    Let your customers purchase their tickets in their native language when using our ticketing pages based upon their browser settings.
  • 👍 Social Media Sharing
    All of our ticket pages have social media links so they can share your event to their friends increasing your sales.
  • 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Team Support
    Allow your team to manage your events with their own accounts, with the ability to restrict permissions depending on their needs.
  • 📅 Calendar Integration
    Allow attendees to add the event to their online calendar with direct links to Gmail, Outlook and Yahoo or download an ICS File for other services.
  • 📈 Analytic Tools
    Find out important information on where your customers are coming from, ie. country with our analytical tools with the ability to add Google Analytics, and META Pixel on your ticketing pages.
  • ✉️ Mass Contact
    Message your customers before the event with our mass contact tool, detailing important information they need to know.
  • 🧾 Automatic Tax Rules
    Charge tax rules on each of your tickets to collect for tax purposes such as VAT tax in the United Kingdom.
  • 🗺️ Track Your Activity
    Find out in real time what your users are doing on your cart and with our analytic tools you can find out how well your sales are performing.
  • 👨‍⚖️ Legal Compliance
    Use our privacy controls to show a privacy policy which your attendees must accept before purchasing tickets with payments taken through our ticketing platform comply to SCA Regulations.
  • 🔗 SEO Optimised Pages
    All our tickets pages are optimised for SEO, with Event Schemas enabled automatically so your events are listed on search engines.
  • ☁️ Cloud Based
    All the data is stored on our servers so you do not have to worry about securing your ticketing data.
  • 💨 Not Fixed To WordPress
    Your data is hosted on the cloud, with the ability to use our hosted pages, or it host it on another service in the future if you decide to move away from WordPress.

Find out more about Ticketmeo and our features we provide to you.

  • ✅ No pro options, all features are available to all customers.
  • ✅ Easy to setup, get started in minutes.
  • ✅ No monthly or upfront fees with multiple currency support including GBP, EUR, USD, AUD, CAD and more. Find out the pricing for your currency.
  • ✅ No charge for customers reserving attendees. Free events are free.
  • ✅ White label solution, no Ticketmeo branding on any frontend pages if set.
  • ✅ No limit to the number of tickets you can sell.
  • ✅ No limit to the number of events which you can host at the same time.
  • ✅ Collect your payments via credit card or debit card directly to your Stripe or PayPal account.
  • ✅ No waiting time for payments to be received. Payments are send immediately to your account.
  • ✅ Multi language support on all our ticket pages, automatically selected using your customers browser settings.
  • ✅ Change the colour of your ticketing pages to fit your brand.
  • ✅ Your data is yours, we do not use your customers data for any marketing purposes.
  • ✅ Simple easy to use control panel with no complex and confusing features.
  • ✅ Ability to add addons to improve your experience with automated features such as MailChimp, Google Analytics and Zapier just to name a few.
  • ✅ Human, UK based support, for all users (no premium needed)

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin.
  2. Install the plugin by going into your WordPress admin panel. Once inside go to Plugins -> Add New. You will now be on the page with all the plugins available. From here click the ‘Upload Plugin’ button and upload the ZIP which you downloaded in the last step. You have now successfully installed the plugin.
  3. Activate the plugin. Once the plugin has been installed it should be listed on the installed plugins page (Plugins -> Installed Plugins) as Ticketmeo. The final step is to make sure that the plugin is active.
  4. Register and sign up to Ticketmeo for free and create your event first at https://account.ticketmeo.com/events/create, this should only take a few minutes.
  5. Use our WordPress Integration script which can be found from your event dashboard, copy and paste this short code into your WordPress post or page and it will automatically display.
  6. Sell tickets to your attendees, without them ever leaving your website.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

No Ticketmeo, works independent of WooCommerce. We pay all payments direct to your PayPal or Stripe account.

Wait is your plugin free?

Yes the Ticketmeo plugin is free to install, we take a booking fee with paid events. If you only host free events, then there is no charge to use Ticketmeo.

Help I have problem where do I get help?

Sign up for Ticketmeo and use our support system, we always happy to help you with your problems. Alternatively post on our WordPress Plugin page we often check to see if there is anyone asking for help here.
